name: Sore ga Bokura no Ren'ai Seikatsu Fandisc
original_name: それが僕等の恋愛生活 Fandisc
source:
Three months later main character finally gets used to the life in dormitory. Today he feels lonely and starts walking around the campus to try to find the soul mate.
